title: SAH and Hcy Accumulation in Yeast and Drosophila
summary: This cluster is centered around the accumulation of SAH and Hcy in yeast and Drosophila. SAH accumulation is associated with CVD, while Hcy accumulation is an indicator of CVD. SAHH, a gene or protein, causes growth defects in Canton-S and w[1118] flies and is encoded by Δsah1. PL methylation, a process or phenotype, produces dimethylphosphatidylethanolamine and is present in mammals. Yeast and Drosophila have been analyzed using various methods, including NMR, Precellys 24 tissue homogenizer, and Agilent 1260 HPLC Infinity system. The cluster also includes various chemicals, such as SAM, ADMA, and PC, which are involved in PL methylation and other processes.
